Title: Azure Container Registry singularity image files (SIF) support is now in preview

Body.Content:
The Singularity project defines a new secure singularity image format (SIF) which enables untrusted users to run untrusted containers in a trusted way. The work done in collaboration with Sylabs enables customers using Singularity to use their investments in Azure Container Registry and other OCI-compliant registries, without having to run and maintain another SIF distribution library.

Learn more
